title: Practice 2: Every day, all week, on Saturdays

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.ru: Ей-богу, хорошеет и полнеет не по ___, а по часам!
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Антон Чехов, «Иванов».

exercises.q: Tatoeba's founder Trang Ho has stepped back in recent years.
exercises.ru: Основательница Татоэбы Чанг Хо в ___ отошла от дел.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Роздых и умягчение фараонским душам бывает только по ___ (четверги).
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Александр Куприн, «Юнкера».
«в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom has been sick all winter.
exercises.why: «весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.ru: Посмотри: он стареет не по дням, а по ___.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Антон Чехов, «Чёрный монах».

exercises.q: Did you see the fireworks display on New Year's Eve?
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Come to think of it, it has been raining for a week.
exercises.why: «целый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«по» + dative. From Сергей Есенин, «Анна Снегина».

exercises.prompt: People said so in the sixties.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.ru: А кто, по ___, самые сильные люди?
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Максим Горький, «Фома Гордеев».

exercises.q: We live in the age of technology.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: I'll just take a minute of your time.
exercises.why: «весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: А бывало, по ___ (месяц) человека не увидишь.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Александр Островский, «Последняя жертва».

exercises.q: Уверен, в ___ (ближайшая неделя) мы отобьём город.
exercises.prompt: I'm certain we're retaking the city within a week.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I wash my face every evening to get my makeup off.
exercises.ru: Я умываю лицо ___, чтобы смыть макияж.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.ru: Нет, они по ___ раньше десяти никогда не приходят.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Юрий Тынянов, «Кюхля».

exercises.q: Tom is almost always at home on Sundays.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
